Week 1 Monday Night Madness

Season 5 is officially live and half the league already learned that starting a defense can actively hurt you.

GGs

Achane Smokin CiGarretts vs Pukachu
John dropped 159.46 and beat Noah by 75.2, which is what happens when Caleb Williams goes for 37.26 and Noah's tight end posts a clean 0.0.

The Aura Farm vs The Basement Of KK
Peter squeaked by 113.76 to 112.4, a 1.4 win that Christian can thank Brandon Aubrey and his 2.0 for.

3% Isaac
A Slap in the Face vs PA Dive Your Way
Isaac trails Kaleb by 22.9 with only Bo Nix left, projected 16.1, and Kaleb still has Harrison Butker sitting there at 8.9. So Isaac needs Nix to roughly double his projection while a Chiefs kicker does nothing all night. Not happening.

11% Leif
Joey Lunchbox vs Finding Nico
Leif leads by 6.8 and is completely done, while Mitchell still has Courtland Sutton at 11.7 and the Broncos D/ST at 5.9. Leif needs Denver to forget Sutton exists and the defense to go negative, which is possible, just not likely.

31% CJ
Amon that inhaler vs Burrowed Treasure
CJ trails Grant by 6.9 with Rashee Rice left, projected 14.4, against Jaylen Waddle at 12.2 for Grant. Basically a Rice minus Waddle bet, and CJ needs to clear that gap by 7. Live, genuinely.

48% Adam
Uncut Cokerr vs Runnin' Rezac
Adam is down 15.1 with Kenneth Walker III as the last man standing, projected 14.7, and Logan is finished at 137.22. Walker has to beat his projection outright, so Adam needs a touchdown or two in Kansas City. Coin flip with the defending champ.

John takes the week with 159.46 and it isn't close.

Fun MNF game so send picks. I want a first TD winner. Good luck players and happy Monday!
